text:
rui: Quick flag  users on Next/Edge seeing `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for @redwood/sdk-js after upgrade. Their build resolves to index.cjs even though we ship ESM now.

pat: I checked the npm pack from the release tag  tarball only contains dist/index.js and dist/index.cjs. No dist/index.mjs, no .map, no types. Our publish workflow's file globs were too narrow.

rui: That explains sourcemap-less traces too. Edge runtimes need ESM entrypoints.

ci-bot: Repro steps added: `npm pack && tar -xzf *.tgz && ls package/dist` shows missing .mjs/.map/.d.ts. Pack-check job failed on previous release but was skipped on this branch.

pat: Proposed hotfix: republish patch with package.json fields: "main": "dist/index.cjs", "module": "dist/index.mjs", "types": "dist/index.d.ts", and add an `exports` map. Update publish workflow to include dist/* (no ext filter) and run `npm pack` in CI to assert contents.

zoe: Pushed PR that: 1) updates files in package.json to include dist/*.mjs, dist/*.map, dist/*.d.ts 2) adds exports map 3) adds pack-check step to release CI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1288

rui: Thanks. Can we also add a tiny smoke test that installs the tarball into the Next example and does an import as ESM so we catch regressions?

pat: Yep added. Smoke test uses `node --input-type=module -e "import('./tmp/package/dist/index.mjs')"` and a CJS require check.

ci-bot: New pack-check passed on PR. Tarball contains index.mjs, index.cjs, index.d.ts, and index.js.map.

rui: Planning to cut 2.2.1 patch after CI green. Will notify affected users and add a publishing checklist to devex docs.
